title: Home practical guide and safety card: rusting nails
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Metals and their uses (8G); energy transfers (8K)
source: Written for science/y8 lesson 44 (Home practical guide and safety card: rusting nails (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 44: Corrosion and rusting. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out what iron needs to rust
equipment: Tap water, cooled boiled water (adult boils), cooking oil
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Jar A: a nail in tap water (air and water)
Jar B: a nail in cooled boiled water with a layer of oil on top (water, no air)
Jar C: a nail in a dry jar with a lid (air, no water)
Keep the type of nail, time and place the same
Leave for a week; check every two days
Record and conclude what iron needs to rust

questions.q: Big question: why does the anchor rust but the drawer nail does not?
questions.a: The anchor has water and oxygen (and salt); the drawer is dry.
